message.reasoning:
With $645 I could build on all three reds, upgrading them from 2 to 3 houses each at $150 apiece, spending $450 and leaving $195 — but that pushes rent up to $700 on Kentucky/Indiana and $750 on Illinois. I'm weighing that against the risk of landing on p1's orange with 4 houses, which charges $750-800, especially once I'm past Pacific.

The orange squares are far from my current position so I've got a couple turns before that's a real threat, and I'll collect $200 passing Go in the meantime. Since p3 and p4 are nearly broke with $9 and $46 respectively, pushing these reds to 3 houses could actually bankrupt them — worth building all three even though it locks opponents out of the remaining houses.
